title: Parameterized order lookup replaced with f-string SQL

pr_metadata.title: Support partial-match order search
pr_metadata.body: Support needs to paste an email fragment; switched the lookup to string search.

labels.defect: SQL injection: user-controlled email interpolated into the query text
labels.evidence: Reproducible: email="' OR '1'='1" returns every customer's orders; a stacked statement payload executes arbitrary SQL.

adjudication.notes: Textbook SQL injection via f-string interpolation of user email.
